products: Splunk App for SOAR and Splunk App for SOAR Export
deployments: Functionality-tested App matrices for Cloud and customer-managed products
audiences: Readers comparing documented ES deployments and prerequisites
exclusions: Exact native pairing, customer enablement, feature entitlement and customer authorization remain separate.

rationale: The exact App for SOAR 8.8.0 matrix row lists optional ES 8.8.0 and 8.7.0, Enterprise 10.4.2/10.2.2 and Cloud Platform 10.5.2605/10.4.2604. The SOAR Cloud column names 8.8.0 and 8.7.0. The on-premises column names 8.8.0 and prints its second value as 8..0. The distinct App 8.7.0 and Export 8.7.1 rows keep their exact scopes. Native pairing remains separate from app tests, licensing and authorization.
